title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Open Amount of a Demurrage Invoice Line for Goodwill
content:
## Principle

Commercial goodwill on the demurrage of a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record is a reduction of the demurrage invoice line that the record's account shows. Its size is measured from that line's invoiced amount, and it is booked against that line's invoice reference.

## The amount still open on the line

To find what is still open, start from the invoiced amount of the demurrage line and take away each waiver and each dispute credit whose reference is that line, whoever granted it; what remains, never a negative figure, is the amount still open.

| Input from the account | Treatment |
|---|---|
| invoiced amount of the demurrage line | the starting figure |
| waivers booked against that line, of any reason | deducted |
| dispute credits booked against that line | deducted |
| payments on the record | not deducted, since they are not booked against the line |
| entries booked against some other invoice line | not deducted |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- A demurrage line invoiced at 900.00, with a waiver of 100.00 and a dispute credit of 150.00 both referencing it: the amount still open is 650.00.
- A demurrage line invoiced at 400.00 with nothing yet referencing it: the amount still open is 400.00.
- A line invoiced at 300.00 against which credits totalling 300.00 are booked: the amount still open is nothing.
